sf_subtitle: Generate a candidate preview first, then confirm to apply; a rollback snapshot is written for every affected image.
sf_preset_dedupe_desc: Keep the larger instance when same-class instances highly overlap; good for cleaning duplicate batch boxes.
sf_preset_canonical_desc: Merge source classes into a target class, e.g. face/head into human face.
sf_preset_cleanup_desc: Delete small noise or low-score instances within a class scope; preview required before applying.
sf_preset_delete_desc: Delete image files without any annotations plus their annotation JSON; good for cleaning empty samples.
sf_hint_merge: Merge filter: handles duplicate annotations or merges source classes into a target class. Rule conditions are not used in this mode.
sf_hint_rule: Rule filter: only selects annotations hitting the checked rules and deletes them after confirmation. No relabeling or merging in this mode.
sf_hint_delete: Delete unlabeled images: scans images without any annotation in the project and, after confirmation, deletes the image files and the matching JSON under annotations. This cannot be rolled back via data cleaning.
sf_coverage_hint: Delete the smaller instance once the larger one covers it by this ratio.
sf_rule_warning: Rule filter only deletes hit annotations; it never relabels or merges. Preview first and confirm the hit scope before deleting.
sf_rule_small_hint: Only delete objects whose area ratio is at most this value.
sf_rule_count_hint: Only delete annotations of images whose total instance count falls in this range. Left is the minimum, right the maximum; 0 means no upper bound.
sf_rule_pos_hint: Annotations hitting the center rectangle are deleted.
sf_rule_conf_hint: Only delete annotations whose confidence falls in this interval. Left is the minimum score, right the maximum.
sf_idle_hint: Run a preview first to inspect the hits.
sf_job_not_found: Data cleaning job status not found
sf_no_job_id: Data cleaning job returned no job_id

sf_need_one_rule: Enable at least one rule condition
sf_confirm_merge: Apply the merge filter according to the preview results?
sf_confirm_delete_unlabeled: Delete all unlabeled images? This removes the image files and their annotation JSON and cannot be rolled back via data cleaning.
sf_confirm_rule: Delete all annotations hitting the rules? This modifies annotations directly.
sf_rollback_desc: Affected {{changed}} images, removed {{removed}}, relabeled {{relabeled}}. Rolling back restores these images to their pre-cleaning annotation snapshots.
sf_rollback_confirm: Roll back the latest data cleaning run? Affected images will be restored to their pre-cleaning annotation snapshots.
sf_no_unlabeled: This project has no unlabeled images.
sf_no_merge_candidates: No candidate images under the current merge rule.
sf_no_rule_hits: No annotations hit under the current rules.
sf_item_delete_hint: Image and its annotation JSON to be deleted
sf_orig_missing: Image file not deleted or missing
sf_json_missing: Annotation JSON not deleted or missing
sf_ruletext_delete_1: Delete unlabeled images: scans images whose annotation array is empty, then deletes those image files and the matching JSON files under annotations after preview. Images with annotations are never deleted.
sf_ruletext_delete_2: After deletion the image index, annotation index and project stats are refreshed; physical deletion cannot be rolled back via data cleaning.
sf_ruletext_merge_same: Merge filter: uses {{spatial}} to detect same-class duplicates; when the larger instance covers the smaller by {{pct}}, the smaller is deleted.
sf_ruletext_merge_canonical: Merge filter: uses {{spatial}} to detect duplicates; when source classes [{{sources}}] are covered by [{{target}}] at {{pct}}, they are merged in.
sf_ruletext_instance_note: Instance nesting prefers polygon/mask to compute how much the smaller instance is covered; it falls back to bbox nesting when instance contours are missing.
sf_ruletext_keep: Kept objects are decided by {{area}}: the larger instance is kept by default. This mode only performs merge/relabel logic and never applies rule deletions.
sf_ruletext_rule_head: Rule filter: searches annotations hitting the rules within [{{classes}}], then deletes the hits after preview.
sf_ruletext_need_one: Enable at least one rule condition, otherwise deletion is not allowed.
